title: Pin the route-class vocabulary across all four documents that name it
action: Write a NEW integration test file under packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/, following the pure-filesystem shape of specs_fence.rs:17-18 (std only, no crate import). ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES is pub(crate) and CANNOT be imported from an integration test — read workflows.rs as TEXT to extract both ROUTE_CLASS_VALUES and ROUTE_LANE_VALUES. Do NOT re-declare either list in the test: close.rs:403-406 already did that once (const FEATURE_ROUTE_LANE_CLASSES) and duplication is the defect this whole feature exists to remove. The test asserts two things: (1) each of the four source documents naming the enum lists exactly the class values — skills/bee-hive/references/scout-and-ticks.md:34, docs/product-description/goal.md:48, docs/product-description/lifecycle/planning.md:35, docs/product-description/verification/lifecycle.md:114; (2) no class value is also a lane value, so the `mode`-carries-a-class leak stays harmless for every future class. Read SOURCE files only — the rendered plugin copies under .claude-plugin/ etc are regen output, not a second truth. Write the test red-first: it must fail before the doc sites are updated in psa-3.
acceptance: The new test exists, imports nothing from the bee crate, and re-declares neither constant. It fails on the pre-psa-3 tree (three doc sites still list seven values) and the failure names which document is stale. The no-class-is-a-lane assertion passes.

truths: a new test file exists under packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/ that uses only std and imports nothing from the bee crate
the test contains no literal list of class or lane values — it reads both out of workflows.rs as text
run red-first on the tree before psa-3, the test FAILS and its message names which document is stale
the assertion that no class value is also a lane value passes
